description: Lignes de bus et tram du réseau Irigo is a dataset listed in Angers Loire Métropole - Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by RD Angers. Lignes de Bus et Tram du réseau Irigo. Ce jeu de données correspond au fichier shapes.txt de la description des données théoriques du Réseau Irigo au format GTFS L'ensemble des données au format GTFS sont téléchargeables au jeu de données Angers Loire Métropole - Horaires du réseau Irigo GTFS & GTFS-RT Alertes de service. Coverage: Angers Loire Métropole. The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. Its keywords are gtfs, irigo. The portal shows 47 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-08-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-angers-fr-portal.
